overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong cross-platform academic and professional presence with 3,580 total followers. The audience is highly engaged with research updates, software releases (CooRnet), grant announcements, and academic opportunities, demonstrating strong authority in computational social science and disinformation studies.

contentThemes.description: Announcements regarding newly published papers, conference presentations, and methodological discussions on disinformation and coordinated inauthentic behavior.
Updates on open-source tools like CooRnet v2.0 developed for social network and link-sharing analysis.
Recruitment posts for Postdoctoral researchers and PhD opportunities in computational social science.
Major career milestones such as research grant awards for studying online information operations.

recommendations: Increase posting frequency on LinkedIn to leverage its high audience size (1,850 followers) and strong engagement on professional achievements and job opportunities.
Cross-post engaging visual elements or infographic summaries of published research papers to drive higher reposts across Mastodon and Bluesky.
Engage directly with respondents on academic recruitment posts to foster community interaction and boost post reach via algorithms.

platformInsights.bluesky: Achieves the highest average engagement rate (6.14%), with research publication announcements and student opportunities driving strong repost numbers.
platformInsights.mastodon: Serves as an effective channel for technical announcements like CooRnet v2.0, yielding solid engagement from specialized academic peers.
platformInsights.linkedin: Generates the highest absolute engagement numbers (e.g., 95 likes on grant announcements) and serves best for major professional updates and recruitment.
